module origen_028104 (
    input [4:0] Waddr_rst,
    input Wen_rst,
    output reg [31:0] Wen0_rst
);

always @(*) begin
    if (Wen_rst) begin
        case (Waddr_rst)
            5'b00000: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000001;
            5'b00001: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000010;
            5'b00010: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000100;
            5'b00011: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000001000;
            5'b00100: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000010000;
            5'b00101: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000100000;
            5'b00110: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000001000000;
            5'b00111: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000010000000;
            5'b01000: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000100000000;
            5'b01001: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000001000000000;
            5'b01010: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000010000000000;
            5'b01011: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000100000000000;
            5'b01100: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000001000000000000;
            5'b01101: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000010000000000000;
            5'b01110: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000100000000000000;
            5'b01111: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000001000000000000000;
            5'b10000: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000010000000000000000;
            5'b10001: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000100000000000000000;
            5'b10010: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000001000000000000000000;
            5'b10011: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000010000000000000000000;
            5'b10100: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000100000000000000000000;
            5'b10101: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000001000000000000000000000;
            5'b10110: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000010000000000000000000000;
            5'b10111: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000100000000000000000000000;
            5'b11000: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000001000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11001: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000010000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11010: Wen0_rst = 32'b00000100000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11011: Wen0_rst = 32'b00001000000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11100: Wen0_rst = 32'b00010000000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11101: Wen0_rst = 32'b00100000000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11110: Wen0_rst = 32'b01000000000000000000000000000000;
            5'b11111: Wen0_rst = 32'b10000000000000000000000000000000;
            default:  Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000000;
        endcase
    end else begin
        Wen0_rst = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000000;
    end
end

endmodule
